description_text:
The handcrafted eggbox charactes have been developed for interior decoration of rooms to show a realistic and homely feel, while maintaining a very light geometry.
  -    The models were developed in blender 2.79 are low poly models and use the Subdivision and bevel edge modifier to add geomtry.
  -     The number of vertices and polygons provided relate to the base mesh     bee (992(verts)-1980(tris)-faces(988)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((4406 verts)-8808(tris)-faces(4404))     ladybird (889(verts)-1776(tris)-faces(9007)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((4208 verts)-8416(tris)-faces(4208))
    turtle (1211(verts)-2434(tris)-faces(1266)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((5766 verts)-11544(tris)-5772(49406))     penguin (799(verts)-1586(tris)-faces(793)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((4042 verts)-8072(tris)-faces(4036))     reindeer (1031(verts)-2058(tris)-faces(1035)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((4866 verts)-9728(tris)-faces(4864))     whale (1153(verts)-2302(tris)-faces(1154)) for the sublevel 1 model mesh these are ((5668 verts)-11332(tris)-faces(5666)) 

  -     The model is also available as an OBJ or FBX format file for import into other 3d packages.

  -     Two texture packs have been included in two zip files at 1k and 512kb resolutions. Texture maps include Basecolor, height, metallic, roughness and normal and are saved as jpeg files.

  -     The individual characters have been saved as FBX and OBJ files are saved as both base mesh (modifiers not applied) and ...sub1 (modifiers applied) formats

  -     The models are NOT rigged

  -     These models have been opened and tested in unity

Etc , it turn into Iacc format , which means if I linked some sword to the right hand of some character , you can save this character with the sword , but this is not only the thing , becuase you can save the sword as Iacc , acc is shortcut of Accessories , which means that if I have some other character I put it in some pose , and in a different position or location , and wished suddenly to make it holding the same sword in his or her right hand , then I open the Iacc custome folder or temp folder , it depends on the place of the Iacc file I wish to add , the as long as I am selecting the character , I just click on the sword , then it will appear in the right hand of the other character , this depend on the last time I saved the Iacc file position on the body , Helmet on head , Armor on cheast , Tool in hand .
So when I upload a space ship it be in Iprop format , which mean it is not accessories file and be in large size that can even contains many character withen , but when I shrink it to fit a character's head and link it to character , I save it as Iacc , which allows me to re add it to any character I wish as a helmet , this may not be so big deal for the Autodesk soft wares users , but for Reallusion Iclone 6.5 or above , it is treasure and will save so much time and efforts .
Today I present to you one of the spaceship helmet stuffs , and this time it is bug mask , enjoy it .

description_text:
Funny Runner, Casual Teen, and Casual Queen, three monsters who were originally meant to appear in the cancelled animation OneyPlays: The Manganomicon. They were creatures who would've emerged from the how-to-draw manga book that Chris and Ding Dong were reading. However, a fatal error occured in the scene where the armatures of some of the characters stopped functioning, and at the time I couldn't find a solution or a fix for it. Subsequently, I had to cancel it. Only the very first scene made it to completion, and it's on YouTube, and as a result these three characters unfortunately never made it to the YouTube big screen.
The three monsters (from left to right in the first image) are Casual Teen, Funny Runner, and Casual Queen, and are loosely based off of characters of the same name featured in Christopher Hart's Kids Draw Big Book of Everything Manga. All three of them are heavily stylized and extremely hideous, with a unique custom shader that gives them a cel-shaded sketchy look. All three of them are also loose parodies of B-movie horror media.
Funny Runner is essentially a parody of the Tremors film franchise, and is modeled off of a screecher. Casual Teen is a extremely loose parody of IT by Stephen King, particularly Bill Skarsgård's portrayal of the titular villain. He has a floppy weiner and a wobbly chin. Casual Queen, of course, is a parody of David Cronenberg's remake of The Fly, and has saggy grandma .
Feel free to use these models as long as you credit me and Christopher Hart, but do not redistribute them or use them for !1

description_text:
Make sure to use Zbrush 2021.6.4 or later.
33 Creeping Crawlers in various ZBrush brushes and OBJs - highly recommend watching the YouTube video linked below:
Quickly create complex crawlingmonstrosities, or harvest parts to kitbash into something else. Super timesaver and idea generator - quickly spice up 3D sculpting/designing/concepting, or even augment and change existing sculpts. Included you will find:

  - Zbrush Curve brush ConstantWidth: 14 Crawlers with constant width throughout its length

  - Zbrush Curve brush Smaller Tip: 17 Tentacles with falloff along the curve becoming smaller towards the tip

  - ZBrush Curve brush Smaller Tip Graboid: 2 variations of the famous Graboid worms from the classic film Tremors

  - Zbrush subtool file with all the source meshes

  - Zbrush subtool file with all Crawlers drawn out straight, for retopology/baking/rigging in other software

  - OBJs of all source meshes for Blender, Maya, Max etc

  - OBJs of all Crawlers drawn out straight, for retopology/baking/rigging in Maya, Blender, Max, etc

These are untextured high poly sculpts. All have been decimated as much as possible without sacrificing detail. Please note that the main feature of this pack - the curve brush functionality, is Zbrush-only. For other software, I have provided OBJs as some people do ask for them. Drawn straight out in order to be retopologised, baked, rigged etc, and THEN animated and curved etc. Source parts of these also provided in case people would like to experiment with duplicating along curves in Maya, Blender etc.

description_text: The Accordion Owl is a character featured in Disney's 1951 animated feature film Alice in Wonderland. It is one of the creatures that Alice encounters at Tulgey Wood.Alice in Wonderland is a film about the adventures of a girl named Alice in a magical land, based on the novel Alice's Adventure in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll. This is one of the most prominent animated films of Disney.Alice in Wonderland is the 13th animated feature film produced by Walt Disney Productions in the Disney Animated Canon and was released to theaters on July 26, 1951 by RKO Radio Pictures. Lewis Carroll's books Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass had only a few adaptations before this movie; this adaptation solved the problems of the setting by using animation (the next adaptation wouldn't come until 1972, two decades later). The film features the voices of Kathryn Beaumont as Alice (also the voice of Wendy Darling in the later Disney feature film, Peter Pan) and Ed Wynn as the Mad Hatter. Made under the supervision of Walt Disney himself, this film and its animation are often regarded as some of the finest work in Disney studio history, despite the lackluster, even hostile, reviews it originally received, especially in the UK. Even many people behind the film, including Walt Disney himself, were unhappy with the final result, though it did receive an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Score.

description_text:
An ant rig, in the context of 3D animation, is a digital skeletal structure and control system designed to animate an ant model realistically. Here's a breakdown of what that entails:
Core Components of an Ant Rig:
Skeleton (Joints):This forms the underlying framework of the ant, defining the articulation points. It typically includes:Leg joints (coxa, trochanter, femur, tibia, tarsus) for each of the six legs.Body joints (thorax segments, abdomen segments) for flexibility.Antennae joints for delicate movements.Mandible joints for biting or carrying actions.Control System:This allows animators to manipulate the skeleton easily. It often includes:IK (Inverse Kinematics) handles for leg control, enabling natural-looking strides.FK (Forward Kinematics) controls for detailed adjustments of individual joints.   Body controls for overall posing and movement.
Antennae controls for subtle expressions.Controllers for the mandibles.Constraints and Deformers:These ensure realistic deformation of the ant's mesh as the skeleton moves.Skinning weights assign how the mesh deforms around each joint.Constraints limit joint rotations to prevent unnatural movements.   Deformers (like bend or twist deformers) enhance flexibility.   Walk Cycle Setup:A well-designed ant rig often includes a pre-built walk cycle or tools to create one efficiently. This may involve:Automated leg movements based on a tripod gait.Controls for adjusting stride length and speed.Foot placement controls for precise ground contact.Key Considerations for an Ant Rig:
Realistic Anatomy: The rig should accurately reflect the ant's anatomy to ensure believable movements.Flexibility and Control: Animators need sufficient control to achieve a wide range of actions and expressions.Efficiency: The rig should be optimized for performance, especially in complex scenes with multiple ants.Tripod Gait: The rig must be able to reproduce the ants tripod gait.Purpose of an Ant Rig:
To create realistic and engaging ant animations for films, games, or educational purposes.To streamline the animation process by providing a user-friendly control system.To enable detailed and expressive movements that capture the nuances of ant behavior.

description_text:
Proportionally correct model of an actual boar skull found in a german forest. It has real world sizing, but unfortunately already misses some teeth. The mesh is clean and can easily be downscaled to low poly versions perfect for games. It is also possible to create close-up render without a problem due to high quality 8k textures. The Blender file used to render the preview images is also included, as well as several different file formats including .obj, .fbx and .glb.
Meshes
  - lod0 (89k vertices)
Formats

  - boar-skull_lo0.blend

  - boar-skull_lo0.fbx

  - boar-skull_lo0.glb

  - boar-skull_lo0.obj + boar-skull_lo0.mtl

  - boar-skull.stl

Not that there is a STL file included. But honestly, although I did my best to make it non-manifold, I am not sure if this model will print quite good :)
Textures

  - boar-skull_diffuse_8k.jpg

  - boar-skull_normal_8k.jpg

  - boar-skull_ao_8k.jpg

  - boar-skull_height-map_8k.exr

Please contact me personally if you are interested in the raw files (mesh with 4.65 million vertices and the raw texture maps)
Still questions?
Feel free to contact me at any time! You can find contact information on my website https://flolu.com

description_text:
Tiger Cat Kitten character for games and animations. The model is game ready and compatible with game engines.
Included Files:

  -  Maya (Source files, Rig) for Unity and Unreal (.ma, .mb) - 2015 - 2020

  -  FBX for Unity and Unreal - 2014 - 2020

  -  OBJ

Supports Humanoid Animation:

  - Unity Humanoid compatible .

  - Mixamo and other humanoid animation libraries (MoCap).

  - Removable Tail, which can be used as a static tail in case MoCap is used. Tail can also be animated using the included rig after animation from motion capture is applied.

Full Facial and Body Rig for further animation.
The model is low poly with four texture resolutions 4096x4096, 2048x2048, 1024x1024 & 512x512. Lighting is baked in the texture and should be used with a flat shader (Only ambience and no diffuse).
The package includes 18 Animations which are as follows:

  - Run

  - Idle

  - Jump

  - Leap left

  - Leap right

  - Skidding

  - Roll

  - Crash & Death

  - Power up

  - Whirl

  - Whirl jump

  - Waving in air

  - Backwards run

  - Dizzy

  - Gum Bubble

  - Gliding

  - Waving

  - Looking behind

The model is fully rigged, which means that it contains the bones, controls and additional channel box attributes so that the model can be easily animated in case further animating or modification is required.
The model is game ready at:

  - 3632 Polygons

  - 3620 Vertices

The model uses IK and FK solvers for a better and easier animating. The model is completely rigged and can be easily modified through extra attributes like finger curl etc in the channel box in Maya. It means that you can conveniently animate hand gestures and expressions of the face. The curves used for the controls are shaped in a user-friendly form, making it easier to relate the control to the function it performs.
The model is UV mapped with non-overlapping UV's. The shadows and lights are baked in the texture, although you can add more lights and shadows for rendering and use it as you please.

description_text:
Proportionally correct model of an actual fox skull found in a german forest. It has real world sizing, but unfortunately already misses some teeth. The mesh is clean and comes in 6 different levels of details, perfect for games. It is also possible to create close-up render without a problem due to high quality 8k textures. A Blender file ready to use for yout project is also included, as well as several different file formats including .obj, and .fbx.
Meshes

  - lod0 (180k vertices)

  - lod1 (890 vertices)

  - lod2 (45k vertices)

  - lod3 (23k vertices)

  - lod4 (11k vertices)

  - lod5 (6k vertices)

Textures

  - albedo (8k)

  - normal (8k)

  - ambient occlusion (8k)

  - specular (8k)

  - roughness (8k)

Still questions?

description_text:
Rabbit Bunny character for games and animations. The model is game ready and compatible with game engines.
Included Files:

  -  Maya (Source files, Rig) for Unity and Unreal (.ma, .mb) - 2015 - 2020

  -  FBX for Unity and Unreal - 2014 - 2020

  -  OBJ

Supports Humanoid Animation:

  - Unity Humanoid compatible .

  - Mixamo and other humanoid animation libraries (MoCap).

The model is low poly with four texture resolutions 4096x4096, 2048x2048, 1024x1024 & 512x512.
The package includes 18 Animations which are as follows:

  - Run

  - Idle

  - Jump

  - Leap left

  - Leap right

  - Skidding

  - Roll

  - Crash & Death

  - Power up

  - Whirl

  - Whirl jump

  - Waving in air

  - Backwards run

  - Dizzy

  - Gum Bubble

  - Gliding

  - Waving

  - Looking behind

The model is fully rigged, which means that it contains the bones, controls and additional channel box attributes so that the model can be easily animated in case further animating or modification is required.
The model is game ready at:

  - 3440 Polygons

  - 3427 Vertices

The model uses IK and FK solvers for a better and easier animating. The model is completely rigged and can be easily modified through extra attributes like finger curl etc in the channel box in Maya. It means that you can conveniently animate hand gestures and expressions of the face. The curves used for the controls are shaped in a user-friendly form, making it easier to relate the control to the function it performs.
The model is UV mapped with non-overlapping UV's. The shadows and lights are baked in the texture, although you can add more lights and shadows for rendering and use it as you please.

Black Horse model is consist of three parts: body, eyeball, eyelash/hair/tail.
I am try to render a real hore just depend on it's struct and microstruct, so the diffuse map is approximative single color.

If you want render them in offline (like 3dsmax), you need regroup and adjust them. You can find it in the .max file.

Eyelash, hair and tail is maded with hair and fur modifier and use VRay hair and flur material.

description_text:
Highpoly detailed model of a wolf dental set, with teeth, tongue and gums. It can be used for dogs too.
General Features:

  - Includes highpoly sculpted model in Zbrush, with subdivision levels and UVs.

  - Includes high density Decimated meshes.

  - Includes LowRes meshes with UVs (lowest subdivision level). 

  - Detailed teeth cavities, cusps and roots.

  - Clean topology.

  - All meshes have UVs.

  - Sculpted in real life scale 1:1

Included Files & Formats:

  - .ZTL (Zbrush 2019.1.2) Sculpted meshes with subdivision levels (4.2 million points)

  - .OBJ - High density Decimated meshes. (3.2 million triangles)

  - .OBJ & .FBX - LowRes Meshes. Lowest subdivision Level of the meshes with Polygroups/Materials IDs. (13.394 Quad polys)

Notes:

  -  The model comes with the jaw closed, that is the default position. Other images showing the jaw opened are only for showcasing purposes.

  -  The model doesn’t have textures and it is not rigged.

  -  This model was created with Zbrush version 2019.1.2. In case you are using an older version of Zbrush, you can import the Decimated and LowRes Meshes to your version of Zbrush, and re-project the details, you practically won’t lose any detail.

  -  The preview images were rendered and created only to showcase the model. The provided files do not include any lighting or rendering setup, only 3d models.

  -  The preview images used to showcase the model here are not part of the product. You are not buying a right to use the preview images.

Thank you!!

A deer model with small antlers, created specifically for game development (especially for hunting games), but also ideal for animations, renders. The model is also configured for subdivision use. You can notice that the texture of the fur is much more detailed here than in the models using the photo. For the deer, a detailed rig is also set up (he can even wiggle his ears and close his eyes) and good quality animations are made.

description_text:
Turtles (lat. Testudines) are one of the four modern orders of reptiles. A characteristic feature of the structure of turtles is a bone-horn or bone-leather carapace, consisting of two parts: a carapace and a plastron, and serving as the main defense against enemiesGo to the #Shell section. Many species are able to retract their head, tail and limbs under the shell. Length from 12 cm to 2 m. Vision and sense of smell are well developed, hearing is weaker. The jaws are devoid of teeth and covered with horny plates in the form of a beak. The cervical and caudal sections of the spine are mobile, the rest are fixedly fused with the carapace. The appearance of the shell evolutionarily caused the movement of the limb belts under the ribs (an exceptional case among vertebrates).
Terrestrial species of turtles are common on the territory of all continents except Antarctica and on many islands. Marine species are widespread in tropical and subtropical zones, less often in the boreal regions of the oceans. They can live in lakes, rivers, swamps, hot deserts, tropical forests, mountain slopes, cultivated lands, sea coasts, and oceans. Most species lead a semi-aquatic lifestyle. In cold and dry seasons, they can hibernate. Land and sea - mainly herbivorous; freshwater species - usually carnivorous: they can eat fish, amphibians, invertebrates. They usually mate on land, where they lay eggs (from one to several hundred pieces). Some species may have up to 3 or more clutches per year. Eggs are spherical or elliptical, covered in most land species with a calcareous shell, and in marine and some freshwater species with a leathery shell. The incubation period is usually 2-3 months (in the elephant tortoise 6-7 months). Maturity occurs at the age of 2-3 years. Growth is unlimited, but in mature individuals it slows down. Life expectancy up to several decades, sometimes up to 150 years.

With no other relatives to live with, Mr. Cunneyworth willingly allowed Dr. Paradigm to merge his genetic codes with those of a moray eel and an electric eel. As Repteel he feeds on electricity and shoots miniature eels from his hands (which are also charged with electricity).

description_text:
Cartoon Style T-rex made in Blender 3.1.2
Scene:

  - 4 meshes + 1 armature + 2 lights + 1 camera

  - ready for rendering (the lights visibility only turned off in the viewport)

Objects:

  - are uniquely named

  - are classified in different collections

Topology:

  - subdivision ready

  - only quads

  - perfectly mirrored

Armature:

  - 65 bones

  - 87 joints

  - bones are uniquely named

UV:

  - every mesh has it's unique UVmap

  - no UVmap is overlapping

Textures:

  - t-rex_basecolor; eye_diffuse; teeth_diffuse; tongue_diffuse

  - 4k textures

  - in case any texture is missing there is a .zip file containing all of them

Animations (see them in the YouTube video):

  - idle: 60 keyframes; looping

  - walking: 46 keyframes; looping

  - running: 30 keyframes; looping

  - roar: 109 keyframes; looping

  - (in the .blend file they are converted to NLA strips)

Files:

  - .blend: there is 2 version (3.1.4 and 4.3.2): both containes the same, just the version is different

  - .fbx: there are 6 different .fbx files: 4 for each animation, 1 for the mesh with the armature, 1 with all of the animations stacked on eachother

  - .glb: containes the objects, textures and the armatures

  - .obj+.mtl: it containes the objects with the textures

  - .stl: containes the objects without textureBEFORE DOWNLOADING ANY FILE PLEASE CHECK IT'S NAME

P.S.
I hope I was able to help you with this model. If any questions accour please feel free to ask!

description_text:
Triceratops (/traɪˈsɛrətɒps/ try-SERR-ə-tops;[3] lit. 'three-horned face') is a genus of chasmosaurine ceratopsian dinosaur that lived during the late Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period, about 68 to 66 million years ago on the island continent of Laramidia,[1][2] now forming western North America. It was one of the last-known non-avian dinosaurs and lived until the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event 66 million years ago. The name Triceratops, which means 'three-horned face', is derived from the Ancient Greek words τρί- (trí-), meaning three, κέρας (kéras), meaning horn, and ὤψ (ṓps), meaning face.
Bearing a large bony frill, three horns on the skull, and a large, four-legged body, exhibiting convergent evolution with rhinoceroses, Triceratops is one of the most recognizable of all dinosaurs and the best-known ceratopsian. It was also one of the largest, measuring around 8–9 m (26–30 ft) long and weighing up to 6–10 t (5.9–9.8 long tons; 6.6–11.0 short tons). It shared the landscape with and was most likely preyed upon by Tyrannosaurus. The functions of the frills and three distinctive facial horns on its head have inspired countless debates. Traditionally, these have been viewed as defensive weapons against predators. More recent interpretations find it probable that these features were primarily used in species identification, courtship, and dominance display.
Triceratops was traditionally placed within the short-frilled ceratopsids, but modern cladistic studies show it to be a member of Chasmosaurinae, which usually have long frills. Two species, T. horridus and T. prorsus, are considered valid today. Seventeen different species, however, have been named throughout history. Research published in 2010 argued that the contemporaneous Torosaurus, a ceratopsid long regarded as a separate genus, represents Triceratops in its mature form. This view has been highly disputed, with some morphometric research and the apparent existence of authentic Torosaurus subadults favoring the distinctness of the two genera, according to newer studies.
Triceratops has been documented by numerous remains collected since the genus was first described in 1889 by American paleontologist Othniel Charles Marsh. Specimens representing life stages from hatchling to adult have been found. As the archetypal ceratopsian, Triceratops is one of the most beloved, popular dinosaurs and has been featured in numerous films, postage stamps, and many other media types.

description_text:
Bring the tension of the wild into your collection with this realistic Olive Python hunting scene.
This highly detailed wildlife diorama captures a dramatic moment as an Olive Python silently descends from a dead tree while a Bush Rat remains unaware of the danger above. The composition was designed to create a strong vertical silhouette while maintaining realistic anatomy and natural behavior.
Every element has been carefully sculpted, from the fine scales of the python and textured tree bark to the detailed fur of the bush rat.
Perfect for collectors, wildlife enthusiasts, painters, and 3D printing hobbyists.
Features
• Realistic Olive Python anatomy• Detailed Bush Rat with finely sculpted fur• Natural dead tree environment• High-resolution sculpt optimized for resin printing• Dynamic wildlife diorama composition• Clean STL files ready for printing• Suitable for display, painting, and collecting
Assembly
The model consists of two separate parts:
• Olive Python with tree base• Bush Rat
The Bush Rat is printed separately and attached to the branch after printing.
A trapezoidal connector has been integrated into the rat model, while the branch contains a matching socket for accurate positioning and secure assembly.
This design preserves the fine fur detail of the rat even at smaller print sizes and improves overall print reliability.
Dimensions
Model height: 200 mm
The model can be scaled up or down according to your printing requirements.
Included Files
• STL files• Supported version (if included)• Separate printable parts• High-detail digital sculpt
Recommended Printing
• Resin printers recommended for maximum detail• FDM printing possible with appropriate settings• Suitable for display painting and collectible projects
Thank you for supporting independent digital sculpting.

description_text:
A base mesh I have made of the first dinosaur to be discovered, Megalosaurus Bucklandii, to serve as a generic all round base for all theropod (non avain) dinosaurs that is ready for sculpting, rigging and texturing. I have reconstructed the animal anatomically accurately with credit to the skeletal diagram from Dan Folkes and the muscle reconstructions from Matt Dempsey. I used zbrush for the sculpt and blender with retopoflow to retopologize the model. It is subdivision ready.
The ZIP file contains:
-A 3 level multires .blend file with 3 UV maps (a single, 2 and 4 tile version)
-A .ztl with 4 division levels and polygroups
-A low poly .obj (6,266 faces)
-A high poly .obj (401,024 faces)
-Seperate .objs for teeth and eyes

Hail Brethren!
You've traveled long but your Saga is only just beginning.
Have you been searching for the perfect set of heroes to use in your RPG, Adventure, or Story game? Well seek no further friend, the Mutiny Bros' Shard Saga: Fantasy Hero Pack has all the imagination and creative ingredients needed to cook up the tastiest of game brew stews.
The Shard Saga art style is cute, playful and low poly but don't let that fool you. Each hero weights in at roughly 2k polygons. They even have fingers! These heroes are capable of articulating at high levels of animation fidelity making this pack great to use for any platform you have in mind.
The Shard Saga: Fantasy Hero Pack has 44 different animations to use for your customized heroes. The following animations have been included and can be shared across every hero:

54 Bodies-6 armor types-3 tiers per type-3 levels per tier
204 Heads-5 hair styles-2 skin colors-5 hair colors
75 Weapons-5 weapon types-3 tiers per type-5 levels per tier
No Textures! That's right, everything in this pack is vertex color and uses only one material making sure performance is never an issue. Do you want to use your own shader? No problem! Any shader that supports vertex color can be used.

description_text:
This is a customizable rigged cat.
The cat can be animated.The mouth can be opened and tongue, ears and tail can be moved.The pupils can dilate and contract, the claws can go back and forward.The fur is easly customizable.Eyeballs, teeth, tongue and gum are included and modeled separately.
DOCUMENTATION
ObjectsThe model is composed to 8 objects:
body    eyes    teeth and tongue    Armature (Rigify rig)    2 curves    2 Empty objects.
FurThe fur is composed to 4 types of particle systems (Hair):
Body Fur    Face    Ears    Whiskers
MovementsArmature - The model is rigged,  mouth can be opened and also tongue, ears and tail are rigged.
Tongue and Tail can be moved with respective Empty.
Sometimes during positions, the mesh can take strange shapes. Just press G and ESC.Turn off any Subsurface and Hair modifiers during bone positions for better workflow.
Shape keys - pupils can dilate and contract, the claws can go back and forward. Set the Value.
MaterialsThe model has 9 materials, all PBR and completely procedural; no images and UV Map.
CustomizationThe fur is easly customizable, just change colors in the node group. Leave completely white for default color.
WARNINGRig works only .blend file.Rig incompatible with other file format.

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Excellent notice for you! The Peace Bird is also on CGTrader!So you can have this exclusive item with you.
If you want to see the 3D Model, it's on Skechfab with the title's name: **Olympic Torch - Tokyo 2020**.
This is not a regular 3d model, it's special.
It is designed to _remember the opening event of the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games_, and its clear message to unite in **_solidarity, peace, hope_** ... as one.
The Olympic flame makes this light shine brighter for all of us. (Thomas Bach, 2020)
The light that we carry within, and that today will shine more than ever.
That is why I want you to have this 3D model of the Olympic torch with you so that it will inspire you and remember this message every time you see it.And most importantly: Apply it
3D Model Specifications:
-There are 3 models:

  - Olympic Torch (Low-poly and Medium-poly versions)

  - Olympic Cauldron (Gift)

  - Peace Bird (Exclusive Item)

-Formats:

  - Blend / Blender (Principal)

  - OBJ

  - FBX

  - STL

-UV: Unwrapped
-2K PBR Textures:
  - Olympic Torch:

  - Diffuse (Base Color)

  - Diffuse (Alternative Color)

  - Ambient Occlusion (AO)

  - Metallic

  - Specular

  - Roughness

  - Normal Map (NM)

  - Olympic Cauldron (Gift)

  - Diffuse (Base Color)

  - Ambient Occlusion (AO)

  - Metallic

  - Roughness

  - Emissive

  - Peace Bird (Exclusive Item)

  - Diffuse (Base Color)

  - Metallic

  - Specular

  - Roughness

(VFX Fire animation is a gift)
-Additional Information:

  - This model was made with Blender 2.92. 

  - VFX fire animation comes on ZIP Textures.

  - The Cauldron has two groups of objects: Cauldron (all the pyramid structure) and Olympic (all the additional parts). You only have to put the texture on it and you will see its difference. 

  - Scene lights and cameras animations are on the Blender file.

  - The Low-poly Olympic Torch has modifiers, so you can apply them as you want. (Only in Blender). It has its parts separated into objects. 

  - Fire animation is inside of Blender. (If you don't see the fire, press the space bar to start the animation, so then you will see it). 

Note: If you don't have Blender download it Now: It's FREE!
Thank you for reading this and make this world better.
I hope this item will be helpful to have one of the best representative accessories of the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games with you: 
The Olympic Torch symbol of union and solidarity, for all of us.

Highly detailed Velociraptor sculpt made by me, inspired by the Stan Winston desing made for Jurassic Park.
The model comes in 13 STL's files. 10 STL files for the 10 parts: Base, Tail, Left Leg, Right Leg, Left Arm, Right arm, Closed Mouth Head, Open Mouth Head, and the Jaw. Each individual piece is made to plug to each other, it may require a little glue to fix the parts in position.
It's a 33 cm / 13 inches long dinosaur statue ready to 3d print, render, redocration, jewelery, etc. It can stand on it's own and could very well be scaled to reach other dimensions! With a good paintjob this is a must for hobbiest!!
Be sure to contact me if you need any assistance or help of any kind! Hope you enjoy

Tyrannosaurus[nb 1] is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning king in Latin), often called T. rex or colloquially T-Rex, is one of the best represented theropods. Tyrannosaurus lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of rock formations dating to the Maastrichtian age of the Upper Cretaceous period, 68 to 66 million years ago. It was the last known member of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.

description_text:
This Blue Whale for Unreal 4 comes with a procedural spline animation system that produces dynamic acceleration, turning and rolling along splines.The Whale’s mouth optionally opens when it nears the player, and/or animates intermittently on its own.The package includes 2 swimming animations (slow & fast), an idle animation, a mouth-open idle animation, and 2 Turning Poses included in a Blendspace which can be used if you wish to create a controllable character.The Spline animation system uses a Blendspace 1D to animate the whales swimming speed, and uses blueprint functions to rotate bones along the spline.
It comes with 4 LODs, Dry & Wet Materials, a Physics asset set up for ragdoll effects, and a large range of blueprint settings allowing maximum customization.The Material parent has been planned in advance to allow maximum tweaking so you can adjust your material instances with complete control.Additionally, a demo scene has been included with Underwater PostProcess Settings, Caustic Lighting, Fog, & Depth of Field, along with many Whales, demonstrating what can be accomplished with the Whale’s Spline Blueprint.
FBX formats include 2nd UV Channel for Lightmapping.OBJ Format includes all LOD levels in base poses, and 4 additional poses:

  - tail up with mouth open & closed

  - tail down with mouth open & closed.

  - Pose Left

  - Pose Right

description_text:
The Great White Shark Pack comes with a procedural spline animation system that produces dynamic acceleration, turning and rolling along splines. The Sharks mouth optionally opens when it nears the player.
Download Packaged Demo: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BRzex1RGSjcSVGHapwoaRxQGmtHOO7R4/view?usp=sharing
The package includes 5 swimming animations & 3 Poses used for Blendspaces.It comes with 4 LODs, Dry & Wet Materials, and a range of adjustable blueprint settings allowing maximum customization.The Material parent has been planned in advance to allow maximum tweaking so you can adjust your material instances with complete control.Additionally, a demo scene has been included with Underwater PostProcess Settings, Caustic Lighting, Fog, & Depth of Field, along with many Orcas with their paths set up, demonstrating what can be accomplished with the Shark's Spline Blueprint.
Technical Details
Animations:

  - Idle

  - Swim Fast

  - Swim Slow

  - Swim Left

  - Swim Right

  - Pose Left

  - Pose Right

  - Pose Mouth Open

Other:

  - A realistic Physics Asset for ragdoll effects (includes throat bone for muscle movement)

  - A BlendSpace combined with 4 Animations

  - 1 Parent Material and 2 Material Instances (wet & dry)

Spline Animation Blueprint controls:

  - Starting Distance along spline

  - Toggle dynamic speed or maintain a constant speed.

  - Toggle whether mouth opens near player

  - Shark Length Scale

  - Shark Scale

  - Show Spline

  - Animation Playrates for slow and fast

  - Animation Acceleration & Deceleration

  - Distance for mouth to start opening

  - Timing for how long to swim slow and fast

  - Randomness multiplier of timing

  - Movement speed acceleration & deceleration

  - Movement speeds for slow and fast

  - Intensity of rolling around corners

  - Non-Dynamic speed, playrate & intensity

  - Roll, rotation & movement smoothing values

description_text:
The Giant Squid comes with a procedural spline animation system that produces dynamic acceleration, turning and bending along splines while it swims. Its tentacles and eyes are animated realistically to provide a terrifying deep-sea experience suitable for VR.
The package includes a swimming animation, an fins flapping animation, and also comes with Left, Right, up and Down Poses which are used in a blendspace to efficiently animate the bending and turning of the Squid along your chosen splines. It comes with 3 LODs, and a range of adjustable blueprint settings allowing maximum customization.
Additionally, a demo scene has been included with Underwater PostProcess Settings, Caustic Lighting, Deep Sea Fog, & Depth of Field, along with many Giant Squids with their paths set up, demonstrating what can be accomplished with its Spline Blueprint.
The squid comes with a well-designed physics asset, which makes it suitable for games (the squid could float around in the water when killed)
Technical Details
Features:

  -  A realistic Physics Asset for ragdoll effects

  - A Giant Squid Spline Blueprint

  - Caustic Lighting Material

  - A BlendSpace combined with 5 Animations

  - 1 Parent Material and 1 Material Instance

  - 1 World-Space Sand Material

  - 1 Demo environment

description_text:
This asset was modelled off the specific whale, Migaloo; a male humpback whale often seen off the coast of the Australian East coast. There a two versions included in this file. One is very high-poly meaning that the model works for all types of shots, far, medium and close. The other is low in detail and relies on the texture for detail, good for far shots. The texture is made up of diffuse, specular, roughness and normal and reacts very well to light. The mouth of the whale also includes baleen. That can be seen when the mouth is only slightly open similar to real whales.
The model is rigged and animated for swimming. It includes a full PBR material with detailed normal map.It was mad for a single shot of a 30 second animation which is linked below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3V3IGE7jh9c
Thanks and enjoy!

description_text:
This is a listing for an Exact Replica digital 3D file (STL and 3MF) for the Shark Rocket Launcher (Fishbones) from the animated series Arcane and video game League of Legends. Professionally designed for high accuracy cosplaying and easy 3D Printing. Perfect for your Arcane Jinx Cosplay.
ITEM DIMENSIONS
Height: 915 mm (3 feet) [Standard]
3D PRINT BED DIMENSIONS
Length: 240mm ( 9) | Width: 240 mm (9) | Height: 240 mm (9) [Standard]Length: 210mm ( 8) | Width: 210 mm (8) | Height: 210 mm (8) [Standard]
3D FILE DETAILS
There are slots for LED pucks in the mouth, eyes, and of the gun.
The model comes with 3D printable dowels. However, standard-sized wooden dowels can also be used. Dowel sizes include 1/8-inch dowels that are 2 inches long, 1/4-inch dowels that are 2 inches long, 1/2-inch dowels that are 2 inches long, and 1/2-inch dowels that are 4 inches long.
The body is hollow for convenient storage of a wallet, cell phone, battery packs, etc. There are also spaces for 1/2-inch by 1/2-inch cylinder rare earth magnets to allow the head and tail to be removable and allow for easy access to the hollowed-out body parts and LED compartments.
3D PRINT SETTINGS
I recommend printing the large parts with two perimeter walls, 5% gyroid infill, at 0.2mm layer height. I recommend printing the dowels at 100% infill, flat length-wise on the print bed, at 0.2mm layer height. I also recommend using PLA+ filament as it is much stronger than PLA filament and requires less material to develop strength.
3D PRINT KIT OPTION
Please message me if you are interested in buying this item as a 3D printed kit.
CONTACT AND MISCELLANEOUS
I did my best to position the seams to be hidden easily or easily sandable. I also positioned the slices to allow for preservation of the fine model details when you 3D print the pieces.
Please message me if you have any questions before or after your purchase and I will be happy to help! Let me know if there is a specific prop or weapon you want a 3D model of and I can likely make it for you.

description_text:
The Alien Crab Monster is a game-ready creature package designed for Unreal Engine 4, which includes numerous animations, a playable character, Inverse Kinematics for the legs, 4 LODS, a complete A.I system, an A.I Spawner blueprint, different footstep sounds based on the surface it walks on, and numerous creature sound effects!
For a downloadable preview of the Unreal Engine project (or just to check the model out in real-time), please download the following:
http://bit.ly/AlienCrabMonsterDemoV2
For an extended list of features, please view 
bit.ly/AlienCrabMonsterDoc
File Support:

  - Unreal Engine 4.9 & Above (tested up to 4.22)

  - 3D Studio Max 2014

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - JPG Textures at 8192 resolution

Animations:

  - Idle

  - Idle Tapping the ground

  - Walk Forwards

  - Walk Backwards

  - Rotate Left & Right

  - Strafe Left & Right

  - Jump

  - Jump Loop

  - Attack Stab

  - Attack Stab Left

  - Attack Stab Right

  - Attack Bite

  - Roar

The UE4 package contains two levels; a model viewing level (which you can see images of in the dark room), and an A.I & Player testing level, where you can control your own Alien Crab Monster as a player, and be chased by other alien crab monsters.
The advanced IK system is designed with creatures in mind, as the IK is applied relative to the Pawn's rotation - allowing IK to function on steep hills and slopes without appearing awkward. This IK system is unique, as the vast majority of IK systems available for UE4 do not focus on relative orientation as they are designed for upright humanoids.
The Blueprints have also been extensively documented for ease of modification – and it’s great as a learning project if you need to reverse-engineer a basic A.I pawn with relative IK. Please see the Extended feature list above for more info on how the IK was achieved.

  - [8192] 2

  - [128] 1

  - LOD1=13,328

  - LOD2=8,248

  - LOD3=1,619

description_text: This meaning is different from remote control vehicles operating on land or in the air. ROVs are unoccupied, usually highly maneuverable, and operated by a crew either aboard a vessel/floating platform or on proximate land. They are common in deepwater industries such as offshore hydrocarbon extraction. They are linked to a host ship by a neutrally buoyant tether or, often when working in rough conditions or in deeper water, a load-carrying umbilical cable is used along with a tether management system (TMS). The TMS is either a garage-like device which contains the ROV during lowering through the splash zone or, on larger work-class ROVs, a separate assembly which sits on top of the ROV. The purpose of the TMS is to lengthen and shorten the tether so the effect of cable drag where there are underwater currents is minimized. The umbilical cable is an armored cable that contains a group of electrical conductors and fiber optics that carry electric power, video, and data signals between the operator and the TMS

description_text:
Collection DescriptionBlur the line between biology and machinery with this intricate library of steam-powered automata and brass vehicles.This collection is a masterpiece toolkit for developers building Steampunk RPGs, alternate-history adventures, or industrial fantasy worlds. The set reimagines nature’s most efficient designs as marvels of Victorian engineering:
Predatory Mechanics: Dominates the battlefield with the Scythe Strider Mechanical Mantis for rapid slashing attacks, the Sting Specialist Mechanical Scorpion for heavy armor and tail strikes, and the Copper Crawler Spider-Tank—a terrifying multi-legged walker designed for uneven terrain.
Scouts & Infiltrators: Navigates complex environments with the Spring-Step Mechanical Grasshopper, perfect for high-mobility reconnaissance, and the Iron Invertebrate Segmented Crawler, a flexible unit designed to burrow or navigate tunnels.
Victorian Transport: Cruises the cobblestone streets with the Mechanical Car Made of Brass, a retro-futuristic automobile that embodies the elegance and excess of the steam age.
Whether you are designing a boss fight in a clocktower, a secret laboratory full of experiments, or a unique mount for your hero, these assets provide the gears, pistons, and polished copper needed to create a world of living metal.
Pro TipFor the best cinematic results, use the FBX files and import them directly into D5 Render. The material definition is crucial here: increase the Anisotropy slider on the brass and copper body panels to simulate the brushed metal finish of hand-crafted machinery. Additionally, add a small Point Light inside the torso of the Spider-Tank or Scorpion to create an internal furnace glow that illuminates the gears from within—no complex setup required.
Quick NotesGame-Ready: Optimized geometry with separated legs, mandibles, wheels, and joints for complex mechanical animation.
Multiple Formats Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, plus texture files.
Suitable for: Steampunk games, Fantasy RPGs, Sci-Fi Monster encounters, and Industrial environments.
Included ModelsCopper Crawler Steampunk Spider-Tank: A heavy combat unit with multiple legs and a turret-like abdomen, plated in polished copper.
Iron Invertebrate Segmented Crawler: A worm or centipede-like construct with flexible segments, designed for tunneling or navigating pipes.
Mechanical Car Made of Brass: A luxury steam-powered vehicle featuring intricate brass bodywork, exposed gears, and a vintage aesthetic.
Scythe Strider Mechanical Mantis: A fast-attack unit featuring bladed forelimbs and a slender, agile frame for ambush tactics.
Spring-Step Mechanical Grasshopper: A scout unit equipped with powerful hydraulic legs for massive leaps and rapid repositioning.
Sting Specialist Mechanical Scorpion: A tank-like construct featuring heavy pincer arms and a weaponized tail, built for frontline durability.

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
A textured and rigged modell of an indonasian blue crested lizard.The lizard was sculpted in zBrush, retopologized, unwraped and rigged in maya,  textured in 8k with 18 UDIMs in mari and rendered with redshift.
The files are intended for Maya and sorted in a standart Maya project folder. The shader trees for the textures are done with Redshift materials so if you use any other render engine (E.g Arnold, ...) you will need to recalibrate the textures but that shouldn't be a big deal if you know your way around Maya.
I addet the Mesh as an obj if you use other 3d softwares.(I don't know if you can get the Maya rig to work in another software without redoing it completely)

description_text:
A full and optimized Low Poly package for any type of fast-foods you can imagine !
Files available in .unitypackage, .fbx and .obj.
Works with Unity 2019.4 and higher.
Perfectly optimized for standard and mobile projects.
DESCRIPTION
Over 130 prefabs available, each of them perfect world scaled, with 3 Level of Detail and sharing the same material/texture for the best performances !

  - Burgers (11 objects)Big burgers, small burgers, toast burgers, all with different flavors (chicken, steak, fish, ham...)

  - Pizzas (20 objects)Capricciosa (mushrooms, ham, olives, artichockes), Hawaiian (pineapples, ham, cheese), Margherita (mozzarella, tomatoes, basil), Pepperoni (pepperoni, cheese, tomatoes), Salmon (salmon, shrimps, sour cream), all with different slice part (full, half, quart, single slice)

  - Sandwiches (18 objects)Hot-dogs (ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard), kebab, baguette sandwiches (dried sausage, ham, meat, salad) with different sizes, white bread sandwiches (dried sausage, ham, salad) with different sizes (full, triangle)

  - Beverages (20 objects)Soda cans, glass bottles, carton cups with straw, all with different sizes and flavors (cola, orange, lemon, water, coffee...)

  - Sides (22 objects)Fries, nuggets, onion rings, potatoes, all with different sizes and containers (paper box, carton box, single one)

  - Sweets (6 objects)Milk-shakes, sundaes, all with different flavors (chocolate, strawberry, vanilla, caramel, fruits)

  - Sauces (9 objects)Ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard, all with different containers (big bottle, hand bottle, little pot)

  - Other props (24 objects)Packaging boxes for burgers and pizzas, napkins, trays, all with different sizes and colors.

TECHNICAL DETAILS

  - Materials/TexturesAll props share only 1 texture and 1 material for maximum graphics performance !Only 1 texture, a color palette 64px x 64px.

  - Polygons countMaximum 2.000 triangles for the most detailed object.For example, a big burger with double steaks has 1.321 triangles (192 triangles with the last LOD) a Margherita pizza have 868 triangles (76 with LOD3), a vanilla milkshake has 915 triangles (135 with LOD3) and a hot-dog has 670 triangles (59 with LOD3).

  - Prefabs informations130 prefabs available for your best fast-foods project.11 burgers, 20 pizzas, 18 sandwiches, 20 beverages, 22 sides (fries, onion rings, nuggets...), 6 sweets (milk-shakes and sundaes), 9 sauces (ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard) and 24 other props (packaging boxes for burgers and pizzas; napkins, trays...)All prefabs are scaled in real size (1 unit = 1 meter) and has their pivot point perfectly set.

  - LOD informationAll objects includes at least 2 Level of Detail, with the majority with 3 Level of Detail.

description_text:
Cubone Skull Mask from Pokemon, ready to print and render (anime-accurate) real size
Include:

  - 
Blender files for easy modifications, scale and render

  - High poly Stl of the mask for easy printing

  - Low poly Fbx for rendering

  - Low poly Obj for rendering

  - 
Texture for hyper-realistic rendering (Base Color/Albedo, Emissive, Utility composed of Blue channel=AO Red=Roughness and G=Metalness, Normal, Height)

Programs used: Blender 3.4, Zbrush 2021
Cubone (Japanese: カラカラ, Hepburn: Karakara) (CUE-bone) is a Ground-Type Pokémon introduced in Generation I. Cubone, known as the Lonely Pokémon, appears to be a small, brown, dinosaur-like Pokémon that constantly wears its skull like helmet. The skull masks its true face from view, which makes it a puzzlement for many Trainers and researchers. Its cries echo within the skull and it comes out as a pained and sad melody. On the night of a full moon, it cries, for it seems to recognize its mother's face in the moon. Its tears create stains on the skull. Cubone has a plump body with a paler-colored underbelly, with strong, clawed limbs to carry a bone as a weapon around wherever it goes. Cubone has a single, nailed toe on each foot, with two spikes on its back. A small tail is also present for balance, but it can be used for attacking. Cubone's real face has never been seen before, thanks to its bone mask. When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle loudly.

description_text:
A Low-poly 3D model of 3 rigged fishes and a wall/table frame with support made in Blender 3.0

  - Images rendered in blender Eevee.

  - real world approximate scale.

  - can be used as live animal or for wall/table decoration. 

  -  some fish color was achived using hue nodes in the fish shader, the original colors are: yellow/green (fish 1) blue/gray (fish 2) red/white (fish 3).

  - the golden 3DLIFE picture was made using only normal map for fish material.

  - Note: to get the result from the pictures just turn the frame and the fish 25 degrees to fit the support, I left it standing in 90 degrees to be easier to use in walls.

OBJECTS: 

  - Fish 1: 4887 Polygons 2467 Vertices (rigged)

  - Fish 2: 6058 Polygons 3057 Vertices (rigged)

  - Fish 3: 5347 Polygons 2696 Vertices (rigged)

  - Frame: 1104 Polygons 604 Vertices

  - Frame support: 2558 Polygons 1304 Vertices

UV MAP
  - Fish has a mirror simetry in UV map for memory optimization.
MATERIAL:

  - 1 PBR 4K Material that covers all the fishes.

  - 1 PBR 4K Material for the frame and the frame's support.

TEXTURES

  - Painted and exported using Substance Painter.

  - .png

  - 4096x4096 Textures.

  - Unreal ready textures: (base color/OcclusionRoughnessMetalic/Normal).

  - Unity HDRP ready textures (metalic standard): (base color/MaskMap/Normal).

  - Unity  URP ready textures (metalic standard): (AlbedoTransparency/MetalicSmoothness/Normal).

  - Individual PBR Textures: (base color/subsurface thickness/metalic/Normal/Roughness/AO).

FORMATS

  - .blend

  - .fbx

  - .obj

  - .ply

  - .glb

Feel free to ask me your questions, if you need any help with the model please contact me, I will answer as soon as possible. 
Made by Gabe.

description_text:
The package contains high quality, low-poly model of a boar statue provided with textures for 6 different materials. The model contains collision mesh and it is available in 4 file formats: blend, max, fbx and obj. The object is scaled according to metric system.
The package includes 6 sets of 4K textures for following materials:
  - Aged Copper, - Aged Marble, - Bronze, - Granite, - Mossy Stone, - White Marble.
Depending on dedicated usage, each set of textures is available in 3 versions containing following maps:
  - PBR Metallic/Roughness workflow: Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal (DirectX), Ambient Occlusion; totally 26 16 bit png files, - Unreal Engine 4: Base Color, Normal (DirectX), combined Ambient Occlusion (red channel), Roughness (green channel) and Metallic (blue channel); totally 18 8 bit png files, - Unity: Albedo, Normal (OpenGL), Ambient Occlusion, combined Metallic (RGB) and Smoothness (alpha channel); totally 24 tga files.
In order to use our model in preferred game engine please follow official guidelines of its provider.
HDR backgrounds and LODs not included.
BOAR STATUE was created using combination of photogrammetry and 3D sculpting. Detailed, hand-painted 4K textures allow it to be viewed from first person perspective as a gameplay object or as an element of the environment. Six materials available for the model make it suitable for indoor and outdoor use in various settings, thus it can be placed as a desktop figurine as well as a full-sized monument.
This model is dedicated for video game development, architectural visualisation and cinematics.

IT REPLACES TOOLS LIKE THE MINCING KNIFE (WHICH ARE ALSO USED IN THE PREPARATION OF MINCED MEAT, FILLING, ETC.). THE FOOD TO BE MINCED IS PLACED INTO A FUNNEL, WHICH SITS ON TOP OF THE GRINDER. description_text:
A classic twin bell alarm clock with a lot of details. This clock was modeled with Blender 2.73 and rendered in Cycles.
YOU WANT A LOW POLY GAME READY VERSION OF THIS MODEL? JUST LET ME KNOW!
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, only quads. No ngons! For full and easy geometry control all parts are separated and all used modifiers are not applied.
Used modifiers:
  - subsurf - mirror - solidify
|| TEXTURES ||
This model uses a image texture (jpg) at 1700 x 1700 pixels for the clock face and a second one at 2048 x 2048 pixels as bump map for the back side of the clock.
|| MATERIALS ||
6 materials created with nodes for Cycles Render.
  - chrome - black - black paint - black paint with bump - clock face - glass
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 1.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
X = 0,126m (Blender units) Y = 0,104m (Blender units) Z = 0,166m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials, textures and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and including only the mesh!
|| END ||

Cinema 4d sun with loopable (300 frames) animated surface and ring texture.It comes with After Effects file used to create loopable texture.So you can create different versions of textures on your own.
It comes with 1K animated texture and After Effects comp thatis set up to render 3K animated texture (I did not attach 3K texture because of it size.

Snail is a common name that is applied most often to land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod molluscs.
However, the common name 'snail' is also applied to most of the members of the molluscan class Gastropoda that have a coiled shell that is large enough for the animal to retract completely into. When the word 'snail' is used in this most general sense, it includes not just land snails but also thousands of species of sea snails and freshwater snails. Occasionally a few other molluscs that are not actually gastropods, such as the Monoplacophora, which superficially resemble small limpets, may also informally be referred to as 'snails'.
Snail-like animals that naturally lack a shell, or have only an internal shell, are usually called slugs, and land snails that have only a very small shell (that they cannot retract into) are often called semi-slugs.

description_text:
Photorealistic bighorn ram skull 3D model.
MODEL

  -  Model dimensions: LWH 50,6 x 32,7 x 19,1 cm (19.9 x 12.9 x 7.5 in).

  - Objects count - single polygonal object, no groups.

  - Model is not made for subdivision, although it can be subdivided if needed.

  - Model is made mostly of quads and few triangles. No n-gons were used.

  - Polycount:

  - Polys - 10 227

  - Tris - 20 048

  - Verts - 10 022

MATERIALS

  - Materials are prepared for Corona and Mamroset Toolbag renderers.

  - Scanline and FBX has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.

  - OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.

TEXTURES

  - PBR compliant - YES

  - Format - PNG

  - Count - 8

  - Map types - Base colour, Roughness, Normal, AO, Height, Cavity, Thickness, SSS.

  - Bit depth - 16 bits for Height, 8 bits for the rest

  - Resolution - 4096 x 4096 px

  - Textures are collected into one archive and are delivered in separate file.

SCENE

  - Model is scaled to accurate real world dimensions.

  - Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.

  - Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - All texture paths are set to relative.

FILE FORMATS

  - 3ds Max - Corona

  - 3ds Max - Scanline

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - TBSCENE (Marmoset Toolbag 4)

  - GLTF

  - USDZ

GENERAL

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer (white background) and Marmoset Toolbag (darker background and Marmoset logo).

  - Images are straight from rendering app. No post processing were applied.

  - Please note that all previews are rendered with displacement (height map). If your app does not support displacement, the model may look less detailed.

  - Render scene is included with Marmoset Toolbag format.

***
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
|| SPECS ||
Clean topology with only quad polygons. Eyeballs have triangles in the center.
Mouth and eyes cavities are modeled but tongue, gums or teeth are NOT included.
Model is made for subdivision use with at least 1 subdivision.
Preview images are rendered with Cycles Renderer. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Lights and camera are included in the Blender file.
|| OBJECTS ||

  - Head - 2 128 polys (Quads only) 

  - Eyes - 2x 544 polys 

  - Cornea - 2x 512 polys

  - Eyelashes - 1100 polys (Quads only) 

  - Eyebrows - 6196 polys (Quads only) 

Eyelashes and Eyebrows in Blender are Curve objects so polycount can be adjusted to your needs.
|| TEXTURES and UV ||
Everything is unwrapped. Head and eyes non overlapping. Eyebrows and eyelashes with stacked UVs.

  - 4096x4096 TIFF and EXR 32 bit Head displacement

  - 4096x4096 TIFF 16 bit Head displacement

  - 4096x4096 PNG Normal map for use without Displacement

Displacement map refines head features and adds bit of detail but it is not necessary. It can be substituted with included normal map which gives similar result.

  - 2048x2048 PNG Eye Base color

  - 2048x2048 PNG Cornea Normal map tangent

Editable Texture files (.PSD non-merged layers) for eyes.
|| GENERAL ||
Model is built to real-world scale. Units used: Centimeters. Model is ~ 30 centimeters tall.
|| PRINTABLE STL ||
Printable STL - solid mesh, no holes, ~570k triangles.
|| ADDITIONAL NOTES ||
File versions:
FBX and OBJ file format have only basic materials applied and will not render like the preview images. OBJ and FBX file formats exported as base mesh and as hipoly with 2 subdivs and displacement applied.

Birds Nest Coral (Seriatopora hystrix)
Coral  
Clade: Cnidaria
Depth: -0,3 to –30 m.
Distribution : Red Sea to Polynesia
Environment : tidal zones of protected reefs, protected reef slopes, lagoons
Climate : warm waters
Notes :
The Birds Nest Coral belongs to the Stone corals, which are the predominant reef constructing animals. It settles particularly in the tidal zone of protected reef roofs and lagoons. The colouring can reach bright beige of up to pink. It is a thin branched colony where polyps are often arranged in rows. There are to find however also forms with completely unordered polyp arrangement.

description_text:
Brisbane hasn't reinvented the wheel, they have simply borrowed the popular idea of a giant ferris wheel from which to view the city. Other 'wheels' are tourist attractions in London, Manchester and Perth and give riders a safe but spectacular way to get a true birds' eye view. Fully owned and operated by World Tourist Attractions Australia, the Wheel of Brisbane stands 60 metres tall (somewhat shorter than London Eye's 135 metres) but impressive nonetheless, illuminating the South Bank skyline and river with thousands of LED lights at night and presenting an exciting new landmark for visitors and locals. The wheel has 42 air-conditioned, fully enclosed capsules each capable of seating up to 6 adults and 2 children. Each ride is of 12 to 15 minutes duration (which roughly equates to 3 or 4 wheel rotations) and offers unique panoramic 360 degree views of the river and city.  
The native Sketchup file is in 2017 version, is geo-referenced and ready for Thea Render 1.5 for Sketchup.

description_text:
This model is a high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2k render. Renders have no post processing.Hope you like it!
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Turbosmooth or Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary just drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray and standard materials scenes

  - FBX (Multi Format)

  - OBJ (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012

  - Cinema 4D R12

Textures Formats:
  - High resolution ( ready for 4K rendering ) and named, easy to find and editing.
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.Also check out our other models, just click on our user name to see complete gallery (Venus9).

description_text:
An old 3D model of the twitter bird.

  - High poly model suitable for close ups.

  - Low poly version included in all exported formats - you can apply subdivisions in the software you use.

  - The model is made from separate, properly named and organized parts.

  - The stack is not colapsed in the max version - you can easily adjust smoothing.

  - Drag and drop ready - no background objects, cameras and lights in the scene.

Polycount - smoothing with 2 iterations:

  - Polys: 105188

  - Verts: 52612

Polycount - smoothing with 1 iterations:

  - Polys: 39632

  - Verts: 19834

Polycount - no smoothing - low poly version:

  - Polys: 23222

  - Verts: 11629

Only default scanline materials used. Make sure to use the correct gamma in 3dsMax to get the right colors.
3DS, FBX and OBJ versions available - all mapped and textured.Four type of OBJ files exported for Cinema4D, Maya, XSI and Lightwave.
Please have in mind, that depending on the software you use, the exported formats may not look exactly how you see them in the preview images. In some cases the mesh may appear triangulated and you may need to manually reassign materials/textures .

description_text:
The Sorceress first appears in the He-Man and the Power Sword mini-comic. This version has green skin and wears cobra-themed armor that in later media is occasionally shown as belonging to Teela. In this story, the Sorceress gives He-Man his powers, consistent with later depictions. This mini-comic is the only time Sorceress appears with green skin. This version of the Sorceress was later used as the basis for the character The Goddess in the Masters of the Universe Classics toyline. n the Filmation series, He-Man and the Masters of the Universe, the Sorceress is the mistress and guardian of the Secrets of Castle Grayskull, the source of He-Man's great power.[3]
With a vast knowledge of magic and history, she is among the wisest beings on Eternia. He-Man often seeks her counsel, especially when situations are at their worst. In the Filmation series, the Sorceress demonstrates saintly qualities such as humility and appears to other characters who are in need of guidance.
However, since her powers are tied to Castle Grayskull, they weaken when she leaves its walls. When she does need to travel, though, she generally assumes the form of a falcon known as Zoar. This weakness was removed from the character with the re-emergence of the Three Towers of Eternia, allowing her to travel freely in her human form.
The Sorceress is also the mother of Teela, childhood friend of Prince Adam and Captain of the Royal Guard, whose aggressive temperament is a far cry from that of her soft-spoken mother. When Teela was an infant, the Sorceress gave her to Duncan (Man-At-Arms), to raise as his own, because the Sorceress felt that Castle Grayskull was too dangerous a place for her daughter to be raised. In the episode Teela's Quest, Teela sets out to discover the truth of her mother from The Oracle of the Crystal Sea. She succeeds, but the Sorceress erases the revelation from Teela's memory for her own good, even though she desperately wishes she could tell her the truth. Other than Man-At-Arms, the only others who share the secret are He-Man, Battle Cat, and the Oracle of the Crystal Sea. It is also established in this episode that the Sorceress' daughter is destined to someday take her place as the magical guardian of Castle Grayskull.

These plants are created by the very experienced modeler Konstantin Kim and sold exclusively by Xfrog.Kim (aka 3d Mentor) works in 3ds max GrowFX, and sets up shaders for Corona, VRay, and FStorm.ALL plants, for the first time EVER, have GrowFX (gfx) files included, and WIND, and all models and wind can be procedurally edited!Polycounts range from 100k to 600k. Download includes one model. 
Dypsis Lutescens: Areca Palm/ Butterfly palm  Also known as the Golden Cane Palm, Areca Palm and Yellow Palm, Dypsis Lutescens is a species of flowering palm native to Madagascar. It has become naturalized in tropical locations worldwide, including El Salvador, Puerto Rico, Cuba, Haiti, and Southern Florida. It can grow between 20-40 ft in height, and bears yellow flowers in the summer. It is grown as an ornamental plant in tropical regions, and elsewhere as a houseplant. One of several common names, butterfly palm, refers to the leaves which curve upwards in multiple stems to create a butterfly look. In its introduced range, this plant acts as a supplier of fruit to some bird species which feed on it opportunistically.

Wollemi Pine (Cordaites angulostriatus)
Tree, evergreen conifer
Period: Jurassic to present day
Environment : conifer forests
Climate : warm
Notes :
The Wollemi Pine belongs to the Araucariaceae family and is therefore not a real pine, but a relative of the Monkey Puzzle tree. Wollemis are species who first appeared in the Jurassic and were believed extinct, until in 1994 David Noble, a Wildlife Officer, found some in a groove in a sheltered place in the Wollemi Park (Australia). The most remarkable aspect of this tree is the bark, which looks like a conglomerate of little balls, often covered with resin. The Wollemi pine was a diffused inhabitant of the conifer forests that offered shelter and food to many vegetarian dinosaurs of the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.

Model 2 specs: medium age, 20 meters
Model 3 specs: young age, 2 meters

description_text:
Includes a blender-file with 'T-pose' version ready to be rigged, and FBX and OBJ versions of both the T-posing and style posed Carnufex carolinensis model. No rig is included.The mesh consists mainly of quads with some triangles to be found in the center of the eye, for example. The 30016 Polygons are the amount of triangles that it would have in a game engine. With counting quads it has a total of 15138 Faces.The textures baked from high poly mesh are included in a separate ZIP folder from the painted textures, should the buyer wish to re-texture it themselves. All textures are 4096x4096.
The textures include:Baked Ambient Occlusion, Cavity, Convexity, Curvature, Height, Normal, Position, Thickness and World Normal maps.
Painted Ambient Occlusion, Base Colour, Height, Metallic, Normal, Roughness and Subsurface Scattering maps.
The youtube preview is an example usecase, and was done in blender with a plug in for the sky and a simple animation with a rigify rig.
Please note that I do not claim my models to be scientifically accurate. Whilst I seek to stay true to the general shape they are believed to have, I usually take liberties with colouring and skin textures.

description_text:
High quality 3D scan of a Carving of an Asian Fisherman.
This 3d model has a height of approx 36 cm (or ~14 inch). The model in the preview renders has a 4K textureset. The original 8K texture is also included as well as a 2K textureset. The textureset consists of a Basecolor/Albedo map, Normalmap, Roughness map and an Ambient Occlusion map for use in realtime/game engines. This high quality 3d scan was scanned within a diffused lighted phototent setup, resulting in a evenly lit texture.
The model is easy to use and setup: FBX, OBJ, DAE, ABC, 3DS files are included. Should you need any assistance, let me know, i'd be happy to help out.
Also check out my lately published free photoscanned model, which is for instance great as decoration in your renders! https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/scanned/various/thai-sandstone-female

description_text:
Collection of shark base meshes, including 11 different species. UV unwrapped and with clean topology, ready for texturing or a detailed sculpt! 
Save time in your workflow by starting with a high-quality base mesh. Features include:

  - clean topology (quads only, no tris or n-gons) **DAE files are triangulated

  - neatly unwrapped UVs, with symmetrical seams

  - subdivision-ready mesh

  - scaled at real-world size, ranging from the 75 cm bamboo shark to the 8 meter long whale shark

  - all located at the 0,0,0 origin point, all transforms applied

  - low polygon count, between 1,000 and 3,500 per model

Includes lowpoly and subdivided/highpoly versions of each model. These can be downloaded as FBX, DAE, and Blend files. The FBX and DAE files are properly formatted for compatibility with Unity and Unreal Engine.
Includes 11 species:

  - Bamboo shark-Basking shark-Dogfish shark-Great White shark-Hammerhead shark-Mako shark-Nurse shark-Sand Tiger shark

  - Thresher shark

  - Tiger shark

  - Whale shark

All 11 models together contain a total of 23,740 vertices.

Low poly octopus model. Fully rigged with a total of 99 bones, ready for animation.  All eight tentacles have identical bones throughout (12 per tentacle), and the head is rigged with three bones. Thumbnails are rendered with level 2 subdivision: this includes the wireframe images as well as those displaying the included texture maps.
Try different color combinations over the texture maps, we've found it's hard to go wrong with an octopus!
Included textures: displacement map, normal map, reflect map

  - Polygons (without triangulation): 750

  - Vertices: 752

Available File Formats: .blend .obj .3ds .x3d .fbx .stl .abc .dae .glb
[the .dae, .abc, .x3d, and .obj files are available in triangulated and non-triangulated versions]

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4K render. Renders have no postprocessing.
INFO ABOUT 3D MODELS:Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
